samples.text: A small change is easier to review when the expected result and a way to undo it are stated plainly. Compare the observed result with that expectation before proceeding.
If the available description leaves two interpretations open, ask which one is intended rather than presenting either guess as a fact.

def pending_names(rows: list[dict[str, str]]) -> list[str]:
    return [row["name"] for row in rows if row.get("state") == "pending"]

#!/bin/sh
set -eu
for item in "$@"; do
    printf 'item: %s\n' "$item"
done

service:
  name: example-service
  replicas: 2
  endpoints:
    - port: 8080
      protocol: tcp

workflow:
  enabled: true
  checks:
    - syntax
    - unit
  timeout_seconds: 30
